stemMarkdown: Find the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on ₹10000 for 2 years at 10% per annum (interest compounded annually).
solutionMarkdown: SI for 2 years $= \dfrac{P \times r \times t}{100} = \dfrac{10000 \times 10 \times 2}{100} = 2000.00$. CI for 2 years $= P\left[(1+r/100)^2 - 1\right] = 10000\left[(1+10/100)^2 - 1\right] = 2100.00$. Difference $= 2100.00 - 2000.00 = 100.00$.
